'''Quinten Post''' (born 21 March 2000) is a Dutch professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]] and the [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College Eagles]]. Standing at 7 ft 0 in (2.13 m), he plays the [[power forward]] and [[Center (basketball)|center]] positions.

==Early career==
Born in [[Amsterdam]], Post played in the junior teams of [[Apollo Amsterdam]] at age 11.<ref>{{cite web|title=Quinten Post - Men's Basketball|url=https://bceagles.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/quinten-post/14916|work=Boston College Athletics|access-date=8 August 2022}}</ref> He had his growing spurt late, and before he was on the juniors' second or third teams in his age category. Post quit the sport for 1.5 year when he was in the under-16 team.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=Quinten Post: "Er is in deze draft geen 'Big' die kan schieten zoals ik"|url=https://www.basketball.nl/nieuwsoverzicht/juni2024-Quinten-Post-geen-Big-kan-schieten-zoals-ik/|website=Basketball.nl|date=24 June 2024|access-date=30 June 2024|language=nl|archive-date=30 June 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240630152509/https://www.basketball.nl/nieuwsoverzicht/juni2024-Quinten-Post-geen-Big-kan-schieten-zoals-ik/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He returned to play in the under-18 team, having grown to {{Height|m=2.04}}, and began in the second team again. Post was promoted to the first team the next year and won the national under-18 championship in 2018 as the starting center.<ref name=":0" /> He attended the Cartesius Lyceum.<ref>{{cite web|title=Quinten Post College Stats|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/quinten-post-1.html|website=Sports-Reference.com|access-date=8 August 2022}}</ref> 

Post played together with [[Jesse Edwards (basketball)|Jesse Edwards]] while playing at Apollo Amsterdam.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jeugdvrienden Edwards en Post treffen elkaar in topaffiche college basketbal|url=https://www.espn.nl/other/artikel/_/id/11419634/jeugdvrienden-edwards-en-post-treffen-elkaar-in-topaffiche-college-basketbal|website=ESPN.nl|date=31 December 2022|access-date=18 September 2024|language=nl}}</ref>

==College career==
Despite having offers to play for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B]] in Spain and [[KK Mega Basket]] in Serbia, Post opted to play college basketball in the United States.<ref name=":0" /> He committed to [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State]]. Following limited playing time during his first two seasons at Mississippi State, Post transferred to [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]] for the 2021–22 season.<ref>{{cite web|first=Curtis|last=Flannery|title=Mississippi State's Quinten Post announces his transfer to Boston College|url=https://www.bcinterruption.com/2021/5/5/22421957/mississippi-state-bulldogs-quinten-post-transfer-portal-boston-college-eagles-recruit-prospects|website=BCInterruption.com|date=5 May 2021|access-date=8 August 2022}}</ref> In his final season, he was named Second Team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] as well as the ACC All-Defensive Team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Quinten Post Earns a Pair of All-ACC Honors|url=https://bceagles.com/news/2024/3/11/mens-basketball-quinten-post-earns-a-pair-of-all-acc-honors.aspx|work=[[Boston College Eagles]]|date=11 March 2024|access-date=21 March 2024}}</ref>

==Professional career==

=== Golden State Warriors (2024–2026) ===
On 27 June 2024, the [[Golden State Warriors]] selected Post with the 52nd overall pick in the [[2024 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Luuk|last=von Burg|title=Quinten Post als 52e gedraft in NBA door Golden State Warriors|url=https://www.espn.nl/nba/artikel/_/id/13839447/quinten-post-als-52e-gedraft-in-nba-door-golden-state-warriors|website=ESPN.nl|date=27 June 2024|access-date=17 September 2024|language=nl}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Enzo|last=Flojo|title=Warriors 2024 NBA Draft grades for every pick|url=https://clutchpoints.com/warriors-2024-nba-draft-grades-every-pick|website=ClutchPoints|date=28 June 2024|access-date=29 June 2024}}</ref> He was the first Dutch player to be selected since [[Henk Norel]] in 2009.<ref>{{cite web|first=Luuk|last=von Burg|title=Quinten Post als 52e gedraft in NBA door Golden State Warriors|trans-title=After fifteen years a Dutchman was picked in the NBA draft: Post to Warriors|url=https://www.espn.nl/nba/artikel/_/id/13839447/quinten-post-als-52e-gedraft-in-nba-door-golden-state-warriors|website=NU.nl|date=28 June 2024|access-date=30 June 2024|language=nl}}</ref> He was subsequently traded to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in a four-team-trade for [[Lindy Waters III]], but then traded back to the Warriors for cash considerations.<ref>{{cite web|title=TRAIL BLAZERS COMPLETE 2024 DRAFT DAY TRADES|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-complete-2024-draft-day-trades|website=NBA.com|date=6 July 2024|access-date=23 July 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Warriors Acquire Draft Rights to Quinten Post From Trail Blazers|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors-acquire-draft-rights-to-quinten-post-20240706|website=NBA.com|date=6 July 2024|access-date=23 July 2024}}</ref> On a call with his parents, he cried tears of joy, but when they asked him where he was headed, he admitted he did not know. Weeks later he was presented by the Warriors and chose to wear the number 21.<ref>{{cite web|first=Luuk|last=von Burg|title=Reconstructie: Zo belandde Quinten Post op de laatste dag bij Golden State Warriors|url=https://www.espn.nl/nba/artikel/_/id/13842675/reconstructie-zo-belandde-quinten-post-op-de-laatste-dag-bij-golden-state-warriors|website=ESPN.nl|date=28 June 2024|access-date=18 September 2024|language=nl}}</ref>

On 26 September 2024, Post was signed to a [[two-way contract]] with the Warriors.<ref>{{cite web|title=Warriors Sign Center Quinten Post to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors-sign-center-quinten-post-to-two-way-contract-20240926|website=NBA.com|date=26 September 2024|access-date=26 September 2024}}</ref> In a 30 December game against the [[2024–25 Cleveland Cavaliers season|Cleveland Cavaliers]], Post scored his first career NBA points on a putback following a [[Pat Spencer (basketball)|Pat Spencer]] miss.<ref>{{cite web | last1=Call III | first1=Tommy  | title=Rookie Quinten Post scores first career NBA bucket vs. Cavaliers | website=Yahoo! Sports | date=2024-12-31 | url=https://sports.yahoo.com/rookie-quinten-post-scores-first-102559587.html | access-date=2025-12-06}}</ref>

On 23 January 2025, Post scored a career-high 20 points for the Warriors in a 131–106 home game win over the [[Chicago Bulls]]. He also grabbed 5 rebounds and gave 3 assists.<ref>[https://nos.nl/artikel/2553024-basketballer-post-maakt-indruk-voor-warriors-20-punten-in-een-nba-duel NOS.nl - ''Basketballer Post maakt indruk voor Warriors, 20 punten in een NBA duel'']</ref> On January 29, Post made his first career start in a win against the Oklahoma City Thunder, 116–109.

On 7 February 2025, the Warriors announced that they had signed Post to standard [[NBA]] contract.<ref>{{cite web|title=Warriors Sign Quinten Post to Standard NBA Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/quinten-post-standard-nba-contract-20250207|date=February 7, 2025|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 7, 2025}}</ref> The next day, Post started and scored 18 points with 3 rebounds in a 132–111 victory over the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Warriors vs Bulls |url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/game/0022400745/box-score |website=NBA |publisher=NBA}}</ref> On 29 June 2025, the Warriors exercised the team option for Post.<ref>{{cite web|title=Warriors Exercise Team Options on Quinten Post and Gui Santos|url=https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/quinten-post-gui-santos-team-options-exercised-20250629|website=NBA.com|date=June 29, 2025|access-date=June 29, 2025}}</ref>

In February 2026, Post and fellow countryman [[Malevy Leons]] became the first pair of Dutch teammates in the NBA since 2009.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-03 |title=Post en Leons, ooit samen bij Apollo, nu teamgenoten in NBA: 'Het is absurd' |url=https://nos.nl/artikel/2600799-post-en-leons-ooit-samen-bij-apollo-nu-teamgenoten-in-nba-het-is-absurd |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=nos.nl |language=nl}}</ref>

=== Memphis Grizzlies (2026–present) ===
On 6 July 2026, the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] signed Post to a three-year, $30 million offer sheet.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Quinten Post To Sign Three-Year, $30MM Offer Sheet With Grizzlies |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2026/07/quinten-post-to-sign-three-year-30mm-offer-sheet-with-grizzlies.html |access-date=July 8, 2026 |website=Hoops Rumors}}</ref> The Warriors declined to match the offer sheet, and on 8 July, Post officially signed with the Grizzlies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Grizzlies Sign Quinten Post to a Multi-Year Contract |url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-quinten-post-to-a-multi-year-contract |access-date=July 8, 2026 |publisher=[[Memphis Grizzlies]]}}</ref>

==National team career==
Post was selected for the preliminary roster of the [[Netherlands men's national basketball team|Netherlands senior team]] ahead of [[EuroBasket 2022]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Voorlopige selectie richting EuroBasket bekendgemaakt|url=https://www.basketball.nl/basketball/nieuws/actueel/voorlopige-selectie-oefencampagne-richting-eurobasket-bekendgemaakt/|website=Basketball.nl|access-date=8 August 2022|language=nl|archive-date=8 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220808162812/https://www.basketball.nl/basketball/nieuws/actueel/voorlopige-selectie-oefencampagne-richting-eurobasket-bekendgemaakt/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
